about: Feature -> project requirements for Unreal Engine 5.8. Read by scripts/ue_preflight.py --features. Plugin names are the .uplugin basenames verified against the 5.8 launcher install on 2026-09-08; ini keys were read from real project configs. Every .uproject or Default*.ini change needs an editor restart - the catalog does not repeat that per entry. Spec grammar is documented in the SKILL.md.

pcg.summary: Procedural Content Generation graphs and components
notes: Enabled by default in 5.8 templates, but a project can have it off - check, do not assume.
Landscape input since 5.4 needs a Get Landscape Data node (the Input node lost its Landscape pin).

pcg-geometry.summary: PCG nodes that sample meshes / dynamic meshes via Geometry Script

pcg-water.summary: PCG reading Water Body splines / zones
notes: Experimental. Water Body spline points carry spline width as point scale - TransformPoints downstream needs absolute_scale=True.

megaplants.summary: MegaPlants / Procedural Vegetation Editor trees (Quixel PVE line on Fab)
notes: The Nanite Foliage (Experimental) project setting is r.Nanite.Foliage under RendererSettings - restart after enabling.
GrowerPresets are recipes, not meshes: bake via the PVE Output node (Skeletal Mesh + Nanite) in the UI. The ProceduralVegetation asset graph is not scriptable.
Place at scale with the PCG Skinned Mesh Spawner; the classic Foliage painter cannot take skeletal meshes.

Known 5.7/5.8 bugs: PCG-spawned skinned instances have no collision; PVE meshes reported to crash PACKAGED builds (editor + MRQ fine); MRQ ObjectId does not capture InstancedSkinnedMesh instances (use the custom-stencil matte workaround).
Dense Nanite canopies 'boil' during fly-ins: r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge 0.5-0.75 on the MRQ preset, not an HLOD problem.
Toggling Substrate recompiles every shader in the project - plan the restart for a break, not mid-session.

raytracing.summary: Hardware ray tracing (RT shadows, Lumen HWRT, path tracer)
notes: Ray-traced sun shadows resolved sub-VSM-texel self-shadowing flicker on a small hero object that VSM physically could not (production finding, 2026-08-13).

water.summary: Water plugin (Water Body actors, water zones)
notes: Experimental. Pulls Landmass and Niagara in as dependencies automatically.

landscape-patch.summary: Landscape Patch actors / PCG landscape edits
notes: Patches only take effect on a landscape with Edit Layers enabled - that is a per-landscape-actor setting, check it in the level, not the project.
Render launches always time out the MCP call (PIE blocks the response) - fire with a short timeout and poll the output folder; the render DID start.
Temporal samples bake motion blur - sharp comp masters are spatial N / temporal 1.
ObjectId does NOT capture InstancedSkinnedMeshComponent instances (PCG skinned spawners) - use the custom-depth stencil matte workaround.

ocio.summary: OpenColorIO colour management in MRQ / viewport

imageplate.summary: ImagePlate actors for foreground / background plates
notes: Experimental and OFF by default - the unreal-sequencer-automation and unreal-vfx-automation skills both need it.

python.summary: Editor Python (the MCP execute_python_code path depends on it)

mcp.summary: UE 5.8 native MCP server (what the agent talks to)
notes: Absent ini keys mean the plugin's own defaults apply, which may still serve on 8000 - the authoritative check is a netstat on the port or a successful --live probe, not the ini alone.
Port 8000 can be stolen by a ComfyUI FL-MCP backend that starts first - netstat before blaming the plugin.
The server can be (re)started inside a running editor with the console command ModelContextProtocol.StartServer <port>.
Installs from Fab into <project>/Plugins/Marketplace/VibeUE - a NOT_IN_ENGINE result means it is not installed, not merely disabled.
